heldQuestions.reason: The key requires an induced EMF maximum at the magnet’s fully stretched turning point, where its instantaneous speed is zero, and a decreasing oscillation period. The graph criteria need physics review.

The supplied key labels magnetic field in N and its gradient working uses inconsistent points (4.50 × 10⁻⁶ rather than approximately 4.00 × 10⁻⁶ N A⁻²). Hold all linked investigation parts for key correction.
The key gives both clockwise and anticlockwise eddy-current directions for the same side of the electromagnet. Needs diagram/key review.
The exam and key disagree on part b.ii marks (3 versus 2), the exam omits the number of marks for part c, and the stated question total needs reconciliation.
Part b asks for maximum height using equation (2), but that equation gives time to maximum height; its key adds a same-height launch/landing assumption. Needs prompt/key correction.
The question asks to ignore mechanical friction, but its steady-speed marking criterion relies on friction/drag to balance torque; requires an explicit model correction.
The article reverses the special-relativistic GPS clock effect (moving clocks run slower). The related numerical interpretation and explanation require correction.
The key says an approaching blueshifted object contradicts Big Bang theory; peculiar velocities can produce approaching objects in an expanding Universe. Needs a corrected interpretation.
Exam total is 15 marks, but the marking-key heading gives 14.
Exam total is 18 marks, but the marking-key heading gives 17.
The passage presents gravitons as established Standard Model particles and calls a frequency threshold a photoemission intensity effect. Needs factual corrections before publication.

The stated sending/receiving voltages, received power and line resistance imply inconsistent currents. For example P/V at the receiver gives about 20.1 kA, whereas ΔV/R gives 8.0 kA. The supplied 90% key does not satisfy all given data.

The supplied key uses peak voltage/current directly with average AC power. Correct use of RMS values changes the turns ratio, primary turns and secondary RMS current. Hold until the question/key convention is corrected.
